content: [Slack #fraud-alerts alex Mon Mar 05 10:00 EST 2026] Welcome to the team, Jordan! Quick orientation: we use the ULB credit card dataset and PaySim for training and benchmarking. Threshold rule noted: model v1 threshold=0.5 (ref SLACK-THR-V1-05). Score ≥ 0.5 → case creation. Threshold change requires cost-matrix review.
